list_guardrails_list: list all guardrails configured on the LiteLLM proxy server
create_guardrails: create a new guardrail with name, litellm params, and guardrail info on the proxy
update_guardrails: update an existing guardrail by ID with new name, params, or info fields
delete_guardrails: delete a guardrail by its ID from the proxy database and in-memory store
test_custom_code_guardrail: test custom code guardrail logic by compiling and executing apply_guardrail with test input
